```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Bibliotecas usadas
library(skewlmm)
library(tidyverse)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r}
db1 <- skewlmm::UTIdata # HIV
db2 <- skewlmm::miceweight # peso do rato
```

```{r}
# trajetórias
db2 %>%
  mutate(treat = case_when(
    treat == "C" ~ "Controle",
    treat == "T1" ~ "Tratamento 1",
    treat == "T2" ~ "Tratamento 2"
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = weight, group = mouseID)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, color = "gray70") +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = 1),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    size = 1.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~treat) +
  labs(x = "Semana", y = "Peso (g)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10))
ggsave("trajetorias.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)
```

```{r}
# modelos usando dist normal (sem ser assimétrica com lambda = 0)
modelo1 <- smn.lmm(
  data = db2,
  formFixed = weight ~ week + treat,
  formRandom = ~ 1,
  groupVar = "mouseID",
  depStruct = "CI",
  distr = "norm",
  control = lmmControl(quiet = TRUE)
)

modelo2 <- smn.lmm(
  data = db2,
  formFixed = weight ~ week + treat,
  formRandom = ~ 1,
  groupVar = "mouseID",
  depStruct = "ARp",
  distr = "norm",
  control = lmmControl(quiet = TRUE), pAR = 1
)

modelo3 <- smn.lmm(
  data = db2,
  formFixed = weight ~ week + treat,
  formRandom = ~ 1,
  groupVar = "mouseID",
  depStruct = "DEC",
  distr = "norm",
  control = lmmControl(quiet = TRUE)
)

criteria(list(`NORMAL CI` = modelo1, 
              `NORMAL AR(1)` = modelo2, 
              `NORMAL DEC` = modelo3)) 
```

```{r}
criterio <- criteria(list(`SN CI` = modelo4,
              `SN AR(1)` = modelo8, 
              `SN DEC` = modelo9,
              `ST CI` = modelo5,
              `ST AR(1)` = modelo10,
              `ST DEC` = modelo11,
              `SSL CI` = modelo6,
              `SSL AR(1)` = modelo12,
              `SSL DEC` = modelo13,
              `SCN CI` = modelo7,
              `SCN AR(1)` = modelo14,
              `SCN DEC` = modelo15))

which.min(criterio$AIC)
which.min(criterio$BIC)
criterio[c(which.min(criterio$AIC), which.min(criterio$BIC)),]
```



```{r}
# É PRECISO DO PARAMETRO DE ASSIMETRIA? PRECISA DE MODELOS ANINHADOS (MESMA DEPSTRUCT)
lr.test(modelo2, modelo14)
```

```{r}
# modelo final com base no AIC/BIC
summary(modelo14)
plot(modelo14) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Valores ajustados", y = "Resíduos condicionais brutos", title = "")# resíduos vs ajustados
#ggsave("residuoxvalorajustado.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)
acf1<- acfresid(modelo14, calcCI = TRUE)
plot(acf1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "", x = "Defasagem")
#ggsave("lag.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)
plot(mahalDist(modelo14), nlabels = 2) +
  labs(title = "", x = "Índice", y = "Distância de Mahalanobis") +
  theme_bw()# 103, 150 
#ggsave("mahalanobis.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)

healy.plot(modelo14, calcCI = TRUE, dotsize = 1) +
  labs(x = "Quantis teóricos", y = "Quantis observados") +
  theme_bw()
#ggsave("healyplotmodeloscn.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)
healy.plot(modelo2, calcCI = TRUE, dotsize = 1) +
  labs(x = "Quantis teóricos", y = "Quantis observados") +
  theme_bw()
#ggsave("healyplotmodelonormal.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)
```

```{r}
fitted_vals <- fitted(modelo14)
pred_vals <- predict(modelo14)
dados_plot  <- modelo14$data

df_plot <- dados_plot %>%
  mutate(
    Fitted = fitted_vals,
    Predicted = pred_vals
  )
df_plot

set.seed(123)
ratos_exemplo <- sample(unique(df_plot$mouseID), 6)

# Filtra apenas os escolhidos
df_exemplo <- df_plot %>%
  filter(mouseID %in% ratos_exemplo)

ggplot(df_exemplo, aes(x = week)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = weight, group = 1), color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = Fitted, group = 1), color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(y = Predicted), shape = 8, color = "red") +
  geom_point(aes(y = weight), shape = 1, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ mouseID, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10)) +
  labs(y = "Peso (g)", x = "Semana")
#ggsave("predicaorandom.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)
```
